test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 1 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to replace the underlined word in the given sentence.**

This statue of Lord Buddha is carved __in__ jade.
solution:
The correct answer is "**out of**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 3 "out of"** is the most appropriate option to replace the underlined word in the given sentence.
 
• The **sentence** refers to the **material from which the statue is made**.
 
• "**Carved out of**" is a commonly used phrase **to indicate that something was made from a particular material**.
 
• Thus, ***option 3*** is the correct answer.

 

**Correct sentence**__: "*This statue of Lord Buddha is carved __**out of**__ jade."*
